Resolves #20090

The moveItem test now brackets the Workspace's own FLIP signal (`.neo-dock-workspace` plus `.neo-dashboard-dock-animating`) instead of any element that carries the class.

The move also re-projects two tab strips, and their header toolbars raise and drop the same class within about 25 ms. On a slow runner that closed the bracket before the Workspace's FLIP began. The witness then stopped with the pane still at its old position ("from 1,70 to 1,70"). The shape and the fix are the same as #19894's for the reveal overlay.

Evidence: L2 (local whitebox e2e, 8× CDP CPU throttle, private `NEO_NL_PORT`) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2); AC-3 is hosted runs of this PR. Residual: none.

## Test Evidence
- **Throttled A/B** (red on base, green at head; the same instrument on both trees). A review-only line sets `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate` to 8 right after `connect()`. Base ran `--repeat-each=60` and head `--repeat-each=120`, both with a private `NEO_NL_PORT` and `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`. The line is not committed.
- **Calibration:** at a 16× throttle, base passed 20 of 20. The race needs a gap between the toolbars clearing the signal and the Workspace raising it, and more throttle does not widen that gap, so 8× is the calibrated instrument.
- **Unthrottled:** the whole `DockMotionNL.spec.mjs` at this head: 7 of 7 passed.

## Deltas from ticket
- **No settle before arming.** The overlapping signal comes from the same operation's strip re-projection, so a settle cannot separate it; both pre-operation polls read 0 in all six traces. The narrowed selector alone separates the producers.
- **No CI artifacts downloaded.** Local throttled recordings carried step 1 of The Fix ([repro](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20090#issuecomment-6427025461)).
- **Intake drift probe:** `Workspace.mjs` (#20130) and `RevealOverlay.mjs` (#20103) changed after the ticket was filed. Neither touches a `MotionSignal` or FLIP line, and the recordings ran on post-drift trees.
